root_cause: The arrow key handlers in _onKeyChange adjust the date by a fixed amount without checking whether the resulting date is disabled (e.g., weekends via disableDayFn), allowing navigation to closed days.
repair_strategy: Replace the fixed-step adjustments in _onKeyChange with loops that step by the requested increment (1 day or 7 days) and repeatedly adjust until the resulting date passes the same validation used for rendering (minDate, maxDate, disableWeekends, disableDayFn).
expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard users can now navigate only to enabled weekdays using arrow keys, satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard) and 2.4.3 (Focus Order) by preventing focus on disabled dates.
functional_risks: Potential infinite loop if all dates are disabled (unlikely given typical usage).
Week navigation may skip multiple weeks if many consecutive disabled days.
Boundary behavior at min/max dates must still work.
verification_requirements: Verify ArrowRight from a Friday moves to the following Monday.
Verify ArrowLeft from a Monday moves to the previous Friday.
Ensure navigation respects minDate and maxDate limits.
Ensure navigation does not get stuck when all days in a range are disabled.
